current_plate.title: Hippopotami resting in an East African river (savanna landscape)
current_plate.verdict: Illustration, not a photo. But it is an ANIMAL-PORTRAIT plate (hippos fill the frame) rather than an open savanna vista, which breaks rule section 1 (view of the place, not a species plate). Should be replaced with a plains/escarpment landscape.

candidates.title: Sunset on the Savannah
candidates.collection: Finnish National Gallery (A III 2176), via Wikimedia Commons
candidates.fit: Open East African savanna with scattered acacias, distant hills and a blazing sunset; the strongest match for the plains-and-escarpment brief. Painted on Gallen-Kallela's 1909-11 East Africa expedition (the pick already under consideration).

candidates.title: The Southern Cross over Africa
candidates.fit: A low savanna horizon with an acacia silhouette beneath a vast night sky and the Southern Cross; atmospheric East African plain (sky-dominant, portrait orientation).

candidates.title: Hwandoni Hills
candidates.fit: A bold blue East African hill rising over green grassland under a yellow sky; a striking highland-plain vista (more a single hill than the open Serengeti plains).

candidates.title: African Landscape
candidates.fit: A lush green river valley with blue mountains beyond; genuinely East African but a riverine/forest scene rather than open savanna.

candidates.title: The German fort at Mpwapwa (Das deutsche Fort in Mpuapua)
candidates.collection: Kriegsbilder aus dem Araberaufstand in Deutsch-Ostafrika (1891), via Wikimedia Commons
candidates.fit: Plains and hills at Mpwapwa in present-day Tanzania (the Serengeti's country). Backup only: it foregrounds a German colonial fort and flag, an unwanted subject, and is monochrome.

recommendation: serengeti/serengeti-02-gallen-kallela-sunset-savannah.jpg (Gallen-Kallela, Sunset on the Savannah) - best open plains-with-acacias vista and already the favourite. 'The Southern Cross over Africa' is the strongest alternative for a moodier, more graphic option.
